- **Campaign Slogan:** "पढ़ेंगा बिहार तभी तो बढ़ेगा बिहार" (Padhega Bihar Tabhi To Badhega Bihar)
- **Primary Website:** https://eduschoolsaathi.org/

## Mission & Purpose
EduSchool Saathi was built to eliminate the massive administrative friction that school directors, principals, teachers, and parents face across Bihar and India. Most traditional school management software systems are expensive, overly complicated, require costly biometric hardware, and have poor mobile phone responsiveness. EduSchool Saathi provides a lightweight, ultra-fast, mobile-first cloud ERP that runs on standard 4G connections and requires zero hardware investment.

## Technical Architecture & Security
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture:** High-performance cloud engine with 100% tenant data isolation. Each school gets an encrypted database cluster (`bihar-north-pod`, `bihar-central-pod`, etc.).
- **Zero-Hardware Infrastructure:** No on-premise servers or biometric thumb readers needed. Operates securely on modern web browsers, mobile PWAs, and tablets.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):**
  - **Super Admin:** Multi-school health metrics, subscription licensing, global announcements.
  - **School Admin:** Admissions, fees, staff payroll, exams, student promotion, report cards.
  - **Teacher:** 10-second attendance, daily homework assignment, marks entry, subject notes.
  - **Student:** Class timetable, marksheet download, fee status, homework calendar.
  - **Parent:** Attendance notifications, WhatsApp fee receipts, exam reports, direct school feedback.

## Key Modules
1. **Attendance Engine:** Complete daily rollcall completed in under 10 seconds. Absence alerts automatically triggered to parents via SMS and WhatsApp.
2. **Fee Management & WhatsApp Invoicing:** Tracks tuition, transport, lab, and exam fees. Automatically prints branded school PDF receipts and sends digital receipts to parents via WhatsApp.
3. **Examination & Report Cards:** Supports CBSE, ICSE, and Bihar Board grading structures. Calculates total marks, percentage, and class rank automatically.
4. **Timetable & Scheduling:** Manages period allocations, teacher substitution, and room schedules.
5. **Notice Board & Broadcasts:** Sends emergency school alerts, holiday notices, and exam schedules.
6. **Transport & Fleet:** Vehicle routes, driver contacts, student stop allocations.
7. **Library & Assets:** Book cataloging, issue/return logs, and fine management.
